push-button.name: Connect to your existing email account

section.paragraph: Thunderbird lets you connect to your existing email account, to read your emails conveniently and efficiently from within the application.
Thunderbird lets you organize all your contacts in an address book. You can also connect to a remote address book to keep all your contacts in sync.
Thunderbird lets you handle events and keeps you organized. Connecting to a remote calendar will keep all your events in sync across all your devices.
Thunderbird lets you connect to multiple instant messaging accounts, offering support for various platforms.
Thunderbird lets you set up a convenient filelink cloud account to easily send large attachments.
Thunderbird lets you connect to RSS/Atom feeds to get news and updates from all around.
Thunderbird lets you connect to all the newsgroups you want.

landmark.paragraph: Thunderbird lets you import mail messages, address book entries, feed subscriptions, settings, and/or filters from other mail programs and common address book formats.

Thunderbird is the leading open source, cross-platform email and calendaring client, free for business and personal use. We want it to stay secure and become even better. A donation will allow us to hire developers, pay for infrastructure, and continue to improve.
Thunderbird is funded by users like you! If you like Thunderbird, please consider making a donation. The best way for you to ensure Thunderbird remains available is to .make a donation
